description: This file contains utility functions for string pattern matching, memory size parsing, number conversions, random byte generation, path handling, and timezone retrieval, primarily used within the Redis project.

methods.name: stringmatchlen
methods.description: Performs glob-style pattern matching with support for '*', '?', and character classes.

methods.name: stringmatch
methods.description: Simplified pattern matching that calls stringmatchlen with string lengths.

methods.name: stringmatchlen_fuzz_test
methods.description: Fuzz testing for stringmatchlen to find potential crashes with random inputs.

methods.name: memtoll
methods.description: Converts a memory size string (e.g., '1Gb') into its byte equivalent.

methods.name: digits10
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits of an unsigned 64-bit integer in base 10.

methods.name: sdigits10
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits of a signed 64-bit integer in base 10, including sign.

methods.name: ll2string
methods.description: Converts a long long integer to its string representation, returning the length.

methods.name: string2ll
methods.description: Parses a string into a long long integer, with strict format validation.

methods.name: string2l
methods.description: Parses a string into a long integer, ensuring no overflow.

methods.name: string2ld
methods.description: Parses a string into a long double.

methods.name: d2string
methods.description: Converts a double to its string representation, handling special values.

methods.name: ld2string
methods.description: Converts a long double to a string, optionally human-friendly.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically seeded random bytes, using /dev/urandom if available.

methods.name: getRandomHexChars
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random hex characters based on getRandomBytes.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of a filename, normalizing '../' components.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the current timezone offset in seconds, portable across Linux and other systems.

methods.name: pathIsBaseName
methods.description: Checks if a path is just a filename without directory components.
